svg.text: TwoSkulls — v4: north servo, antenna and standoff clearance
Review draft • 15 mm antenna target • northernmost nominal servo position • measure actual parts before building
Coordinates stay component-side; shaded parts are UNDERNEATH.
Arches = insulated crossings, not solder joints.
*Antenna location and fly-link clearance need measurement.
J3: column26, rows6–8. Keep the cable east or south.
Row5 would overlap the NE standoff/tool reserve.
Row6 leaves about1.19mm under the assumed plug envelope.
18mm-wide WROVER-E antenna, assumed centred on carrier.
Rounded15mm planning clearance around the antenna area.
Connector and its mating body remain outside that area.
GPIO23 starts inside the buffer on the existing carrier:
a short escape wire is unavoidable; RF performance needs testing.
Power fly-links must clear and be retained below socket tails.
Underside: capacitor lies flat, protected by risers
Underside clearance includes cap diameter, support, wiring and shell flex.
Provisional C1 diameter 10 mm; C3 diameter 6.3 mm.
Actual connector tail depth may require taller risers.
All RF/mount gaps are nominal: actual antenna offset is still unmeasured.
Flying link below socket pin ends
Physical gap needs a dry fit.
26 × 32 holes · 2.54 mm pitch · assumed 25.4 mm socket-row spacing · v3 flush socket retained • no verified cutout template or cable interlock
